requirement.original: Issue #3: Make subagent (Agent/Task tool) internal operations visible in the sidebar by sending them as sidechain envelopes
requirement.clarified: Add sidechain event type to wire protocol, update CLI mapper and launcher to emit it, update App normalizer and tracer to consume it, so Agent/Task tool sidebar cards show full subagent conversations
requirement.what: 5-file change across wire protocol, CLI, and App to enable sidechain envelope flow for subagent visibility
requirement.why: Clicking Agent/Task tool cards in sidebar only shows prompt + result; internal operations (tool calls, text, thinking) are invisible

included: CLI launcher Agent tool synthetic root
excluded: Retroactive fix for existing persisted messages

success_criteria: CLI mapper emits sidechain event (not text) for isSidechain root messages
Agent tool gets synthetic sidechain root same as Task tool
reducerTracer registers CUID2 in uuidToSidechainId map
Clicking Agent tool card in sidebar shows full subagent conversation
constraints: Must not break existing Task tool sidechain behavior
Wire protocol change requires rebuild of wire, CLI, and App packages
Zod discriminated union requires unique t values

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Clicking Agent/Task tool card in sidebar shows only prompt + result, no internal operations
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: 5-layer gap: (1) wire protocol lacks sidechain event type, (2) CLI mapper sends sidechain roots as text not sidechain, (3) no synthetic root for Agent tool, (4) App normalizer ignores sidechain events, (5) App tracer cannot link children via CUID2
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Original implementation focused on Task tool only; Agent tool and full sidechain flow were not wired end-to-end
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Users cannot see subagent internal operations, losing visibility into what Agent/Task tools are doing
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Existing since sidechain/subagent feature was first implemented

dependencies.happy-wire: shared protocol types used by both CLI and App
dependencies.happy-cli: consumes wire protocol, produces session envelopes

environment.build_app: cd packages/happy-app && npx expo export --platform web

development_approach.strategy: Wire protocol first (shared schema), then CLI changes (producer), then App changes (consumer). Each layer builds on the previous.

files_to_modify.change: Add sessionSidechainEventSchema with t='sidechain' and prompt field; add to discriminated union
Lines 680-683: change sidechain root emission from { t: 'text', text } to { t: 'sidechain', prompt: text }
Line ~330: expand condition from c.name === 'Task' to (c.name === 'Task' || c.name === 'Agent')
In normalizeSessionEnvelope(), add handler for ev.t === 'sidechain' producing NormalizedMessage with content type 'sidechain'
In tool-call-start processing for Agent/Task, register input.sessionSubagent CUID2 in state.uuidToSidechainId

development_approach.validation_approach: Build all 3 packages (wire, CLI, App). Deploy dev web. Trigger Agent tool in a dev session. Click Agent card in sidebar. Verify full conversation visible on desktop and mobile viewports.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward feature wiring across existing codebase layers with clear root cause analysis already completed
